replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is a bit challenging for me, especially since it's not my favorite subject. I prefer physics and computer science, which feel more practical. But I know it's important, so I try to get by with basic concepts.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. My neuroticism is high, so complex math problems can stress me out. I often doubt my abilities, which makes me anxious. But I manage by focusing on simpler problems first.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math. I mostly rely on textbooks and asking friends. I'm not very tech-savvy, so AI tools seem complicated, and I avoid them.

replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can provide personalized explanations, step-by-step problem-solving, and instant feedback. They can adapt to a student's level, making math less intimidating. However, they shouldn't replace human teachers, just assist them.
